editorial.blurb: Happy Cattle BBQ delivers an all-you-can-eat Korean BBQ experience where premium meats—including standout kobe beef—meet impeccable service and a sauce bar that elevates every bite.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the kobe beef and don't skip the sauce bar; servers are attentive about switching out broths if heat levels aren't right for you, and they'll change your grill regularly to keep everything fresh.
